title: [AUG-150] Add an "Archive" tab to Settings: disk usage per session, storage paths, and selective/bulk deletion of session files
why_we_need_this: Every session keeps its source audio (audio.webm / .m4a / .mp4 — uploads, direct links, YouTube via yt-dlp) and a derived audio.wav (~115 MB per hour) forever; nothing is cleaned up automatically. The only cleanup today is deleting a whole session from the sidebar, which also destroys the transcript. Users cannot see how much disk August takes, where the files are, or free space while keeping transcripts. After AUG-148/149 (links and YouTube) the amount of downloaded audio grows quickly, so the data dir silently grows to gigabytes.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Archive is a full-page view opened from the sidebar hamburger menu (≡), not a tab in Settings.
- [ ] The page shows the absolute path of the sessions data dir and the total disk size of all sessions.
- [ ] The page lists every session with: title, date, source (recording / upload / link / YouTube), total size, and a per-file breakdown (source audio, audio.wav, transcript/other).
- [ ] Each row can open its folder via the existing revealSession desktop bridge (hidden in the browser build).
- [ ] Per session the user can "Delete audio" (removes audio.* incl. audio.wav, keeps transcript.json and session.json) or "Delete session" (whole folder, same as the sidebar delete).
- [ ] Multi-select checkboxes + "Select all" allow bulk "Delete audio" and bulk "Delete session"; the action shows how much space will be freed and requires confirmation in-app (no native alert/confirm dialogs).
- [ ] A session without audio still opens its transcript; "Transcribe again" for it is disabled or shows a clear message that the audio was deleted (and for link/YouTube sessions offers re-download from sourceUrl, or states it is not available).
- [ ] Sessions that are recording / uploading / preparing / transcribing cannot be deleted or stripped from the Archive page.
- [ ] Sizes are computed server-side by a new endpoint (e.g. GET /api/sessions/storage) and audio deletion by a new endpoint (e.g. DELETE /api/sessions/:id/audio); both work on Windows and macOS data dirs, using path.join.
- [ ] After deletion the list and totals refresh without a page reload; the sidebar reflects deleted sessions.
- [ ] NO auto-delete toggle in this task — that is a separate task (confidence score + auto-delete).
important_constraints:
- Cross-platform: Windows (data in <install dir>/data, 8.3 short paths via toSafePath) and macOS (~/Library/Application Support/August/data); no hardcoded separators.
- Angular brutalist design: 0 border-radius on all new elements; color priority schema (red only for destructive actions).
- No diagnostics in the user UI beyond sizes and paths.
- Deletion must never follow paths outside the sessions dir (validate session id).
- Reuse existing sessionManager deletion for whole-session delete; do not change the sidebar delete/undo behaviour.
- Retranscribe currently relies on audio.* in the session dir (ensureWav reuses audio.wav; yt-dlp/direct-link sessions keep sourceUrl) — the "audio deleted" state must be handled explicitly, not by a crash.

## 🎨 Design spec (from AUG-151)

**Mockup**: https://claude.ai/artifact/QwvDNRDKKFWSXcKFGisrir (V3)
**Source**: `@scratchpad/archive-tab-mockup.html`

### Navigation
- Archive is a **standalone page**, NOT a Settings tab. Opened from the sidebar hamburger menu (≡), same pattern as the Diagnostics page.
- Entry point: new item "Archive" in `.sidebar-menu-dropdown` (after Diagnostics).
- Page has a "← Back" button (top-left) that returns to the session list.
- Page title "Archive" uses accent gradient: `linear-gradient(135deg, #00c876, #2dd690)` with `background-clip: text` (same as `.diag-title`).
- Page container: `max-width: min(620px, 100%)`, centered, like diagnostics.

### Layout (top to bottom)
1. **Storage card** — data directory path (clickable, opens in file explorer via `revealSession` bridge) + total size across N sessions.
2. **Session list** — CRT scan-line overlay (like diagnostics), bordered container.
   - Header row: Select All checkbox + column labels (Date, Source, Size).
   - Each row: checkbox | expand arrow | title (with badges/muted text) | date | source label | size.
   - Grid: `grid-template-columns: 20px 18px minmax(0,1fr) 92px 56px 76px` with `gap: 10px`.
3. **Bulk action bar** — sticky bottom, shows when ≥1 selected. Count + size of selection, two buttons: "Delete Audio Only" (accent-outline) and "Delete Sessions" (danger-outline).

### Session rows
- **Source labels**: MIC (green/accent), FILE (text-primary), YT (red/danger), LINK (yellow/uploading).
- **Active sessions** (status = uploading | preparing | transcribing): shown as disabled rows — `opacity: 0.4`, checkbox disabled, non-selectable, non-expandable. Status badge inline after title (green "Transcribing", yellow "Uploading").
- **Audio-deleted sessions**: muted text "Audio deleted" after title; size shows 0 for deleted audio files with strikethrough styling.
- **Expand/collapse**: clicking row toggles file breakdown panel below.

### File breakdown (expanded)
- Grid per file: filename | size | note | delete button.
- **Per-file delete buttons** for audio files only (audio.wav, source-audio.*) — small danger-outline button "DELETE". Not shown for transcript/session.json. Not shown on disabled/active rows or already-deleted files.
- Deleted files: strikethrough name + size, "deleted" label in red.
- **Re-download flow** (only for sessions with `sourceUrl` where audio is deleted): "Re-download" button → inline confirmation panel showing URL and estimated size → Confirm/Cancel.

### Confirmation dialogs
- Full-page fixed backdrop with blur (`rgba(0,0,0,.45)`, `backdrop-filter: blur(8px)`).
- Dialog card: `max-width: min(420px, 100%)`, necron-900 bg.
- **Delete Sessions**: title "Delete N sessions?", breakdown table (audio size / transcript size), danger button "Delete".
- **Delete Audio Only**: title "Delete audio from N sessions?", explains transcripts are kept, shows space freed. Note about re-download for URL sources. danger-outline button "Delete Audio".
- Escape key and backdrop click close the dialog.

### Responsive (≤720px)
- Grid collapses to 2-column layout with grid-template-areas.
- Date/source/size stack below title.
- File breakdown reduces left padding.
- Info rows in storage card stack vertically.
- Bulk bar stretches full width with negative margins.

### Decisions
- **Active sessions visible but disabled** (not hidden) — prevents user confusion about "missing" sessions.
- **No auto-cleanup toggle** — separate task AUG-152.
- **Per-file audio delete** — granular control requested, only for audio-type files.
- **Re-download** — only offered when `sourceUrl` exists and audio is deleted; shows URL and estimated size for transparency.

## ✅ Итог (2026-10-29)
**Что сделано:**
- Отдельная страница Archive из меню ≡ сайдбара (после Diagnostics, кнопка Back): карточка хранилища (путь sessions dir + общий размер) и список сессий с title / date / source (MIC/FILE/YT/LINK) / size и раскрываемой разбивкой по файлам.
- Удаление: отдельный аудиофайл, «Delete audio» (транскрипт и session.json остаются), «Delete session» (тот же DELETE /:id, что в сайдбаре); мультиселект + Select all, sticky bulk-бар, in-app диалог подтверждения с освобождаемым объёмом.
- Активные сессии (uploading/preparing/transcribing) видны, но заблокированы; сервер отвечает 409 на удаление их аудио.
- Сессия без аудио открывает транскрипт; Redo выключен («No audio»); для link/YouTube — Re-download из sourceUrl (восстанавливает только аудио, сессия с транскриптом возвращается в completed без повторной транскрипции).
- Список/итоги и сайдбар обновляются без перезагрузки (поллинг 5 с + onChanged → refreshSessions).

**Как:**
- Новые эндпоинты: GET /api/sessions/storage (зарегистрирован до /:id), DELETE /api/sessions/:id/audio[?file=], POST /api/sessions/:id/redownload.
- isValidSessionId: `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}` + path.resolve обязан остаться прямо внутри sessionsDir; файлы — только basename по AUDIO_FILE_PATTERN `^audio(-mic|-system)?[.-]`.
- session.json: audioDeletedFiles [{name, bytes}] (показываются зачёркнутыми) и audioDeletedAt (только когда аудио не осталось); retranscribe отвечает явным 400 «Audio was deleted — …» вместо падения.
- Отменённый re-download и orphan recovery сессии с транскриптом → completed, а не failed.
- Кнопку папки сделали отдельным мостом revealSessionsDir (shell.openPath фиксированного sessionsDir, без пути из renderer) — revealSession принимает только id сессии; generic «open any path» IPC отвергнут.

**PR / коммиты:** без PR, прямо в master: 437aabc (вместе с AUG-152), версия 0.0.38 — 661e4c0; оба в origin/master.

**Грабли:**
- В макете были несуществующие переменные (--btn-text, --danger) — заменены на реальные токены (--status-failed для красного).
- Формулировка ограничения в desktop-shell route про reveal пришлось уточнить (revealSession по id ИЛИ фиксированный sessions dir).
- Проверено только tsc (server/client/electron) и vitest сервера (456 passed); UI в браузере/приложении и shell.openPath на реальных сборках Windows/macOS не прогонялись.

**Хвосты:**
- Удаление одного трека dual-track сессии даёт общий 400 «audio no longer exists», а не «Audio was deleted».
- Оценка размера re-download берётся по размеру удалённого исходника (приблизительно).
- Автоудаление audio.wav — AUG-152.
